newsitem.title: USA: Schuff Steel gets two contracts.
newsitem.headline: Schuff Steel gets two contracts.

text.p: Schuff Steel Co said Monday it was awarded two separate contracts valued at a total of $22.5 million. It said it also received a letter of intent for a third contract worth about $7 million.

The contracts are for the fabrication and erection of structural steel at the Paris Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas. The letter of intent is for the fabrication and erection of steel metal decking at a new criminal justice facility in downtown Phoenix.
